title: Gulf mixed-layer seasonal cycle in GLORYS
query: Using daily GLORYS temperature and salinity in the Gulf of Mexico (98–82 W, 18–30 N) from July 2011 to August 2015, calculate mixed-layer depth from a density increase of 0.03 kg m-3 relative to 10 m. Compare with an absolute temperature change of 0.2 degrees C relative to 10 m. Calculate the diagnostics before monthly aggregation, plot their seasonal cycles and explain their differences. Use only the supplied public data and coordinate-defined masks; no private profiles, author simulations or additional measurements are required. Report methods, executed numerical evidence, a concise interpretation and an editable analysis.ipynb. The reference paper motivates the diagnostic, but its observational values are not target answers for this adapted input.
adaptation: Public-data method transfer with reduced scope, authorized 2026-09-08; not exact reproduction of the original observational archive.
